item.title: Chelan Banker and Nonprofit Leader Files to Challenge Incumbent in 12th Legislative District
item.description: Stacy Willoughby, a licensed financial advisor and Chelan Valley Hope board president, enters the 12th District race.

item.title: Income For Middle Class In Washington Hits $66,259 Amidst Rising Living Costs
item.description: A new study shows how middle-class income varies widely across the U.S., with Washington's threshold at over $66,000, highlighting local challenges in balancing costs and stability.

item.title: Easter Baskets And Fake Grass See A 2,742% Increase In Demand Ahead Of April 5th
item.description: As Easter nears, Wenatchee Valley families are stocking up on favorites like Reese's Peanut Butter Eggs and preparing traditional meals, highlighting the community spirit of this cherished holiday season.

item.title: Spokane's Local Spots Where Hollywood Icon Chuck Norris Once Walked
item.description: In 2004, Chuck Norris filmed an action movie in Spokane, and he and his family had a lot of fun visiting local attractions. See the list of their favorite places.

item.title: 5 Fun Ways to Experience Anacortes, Washington Besides Hiking
item.description: See what is in store for you to see and do when you visit the picturesque coastal town of Anacortes, Washington. Explore beyond the typical sightsee activities.

item.title: Issaquah's Goat Grazing Trend Offers Eco-friendly Yard Care
item.description: In Issaquah, goats are taking over lawns as a fun and eco-friendly alternative to mowing, helping homeowners tackle overgrown yards while enjoying the quirky sight of goats grazing.

item.title: Man Arrested After High-Speed Pursuit On US HWYs 2 & 97
item.description: A man has been arrested after police say he led them on a dangerous high-speed pursuit through parts of Wenatchee and Southeastern Chelan County.

item.title: Innovative Air Taxis Almost Ready For The Skies Over Washington
item.description: Air taxis are taking off in our skies, with new eVTOL aircraft prototypes readying for short, urban flights. Companies like Joby and Volocopter aim for FAA certification soon.

item.title: Man Rescued After His Fishing Boat Capsizes Near Wanapum Dam
item.description: A Yakima man is safely back on dry land after requiring rescue when his boat capsized in the Columbia River near Beverly on Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Cash Transactions In Washington To Round To The Nearest Nickel Starting June 2026
item.description: The federal government has stopped penny production, leading Washington State to standardize cash transactions by rounding to the nearest nickel. This change starts in mid-June 2026.
